feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?
entry.summary: Research on past recessions suggests downturns can accelerate automation. That raises the specter of a double whammy for workers.

entry.title: TikTok staff raised child safety alarms. Court records show executives failed to act
entry.summary: The warnings surfaced in a trove of unreported court records. "I have been fighting about fixing this for months with people who didn't think the harms are severe enough," wrote one executive.

entry.title: Why are some food prices up and others down? Here are the stories of 5 items
entry.summary: Here's what's behind the fluctuating costs of everyday grocery items such as ground beef, eggs and chocolate chip cookies.

entry.title: Difficult times in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation of farmers
entry.summary: Many farmers across the U.S. are reaching retirement age. But lately, increasing volatility and sky-high prices in agriculture are making it tough for the next generation to take over.

entry.title: Noah Adams, longtime host of NPR's All Things Considered, has died
entry.summary: One of NPR's most gifted storytellers, his soft voice and vivid writing helped define the network's sound for a generation of Americans.

entry.title: Weddings are expensive. How about a grocery store cake?
entry.summary: About a third of couples are willing to save money on cake and dessert, according to the wedding-planning site Zola.

entry.title: What this bankruptcy says about AI startups
entry.summary: Character.AI collected millions of users, making it a very appealing acquisition. Google took a unique route to "acquiring" it, hiring away its founders and licensing its technology. Now Character.AI is filing for bankruptcy. Here's what to know.

entry.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
entry.summary: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

entry.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
entry.summary: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

entry.title: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
entry.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago. The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.
